description: A USDC donation to etzhayyim. The on-chain side is TitheRouter.donate() on Base L2 (atomically routes 90% to treasury, 10% to Public Fund Safe). This Lexicon record is the AT Protocol counterpart — donor's authoring record (donor DID, amount in USDC micros, purpose, transaction hash, optional encrypted note). Per ADR-2605192115 (donation enum + 10% Tithe), ADR-2605192130 (Public Fund), ADR-2605192100 §1.6 (middleman elimination). See `90-docs/2605220440-first-donation-walkthrough.md`. Allowed purposes are RESTRICTED to external religious-corp flows; SBT-carveout internal purposes belong on `com.etzhayyim.member.internal.*` Lexicons (not yet authored) — NOT here.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor at the moment of donation. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, donor must operate a religious DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key).

amountMicros.description: Donation amount in USDC micros (6 decimal places). 1 USDC = 1000000 micros. Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float types in Lexicons). Minimum 1 micro (= 0.000001 USDC) to prevent dust-spam records.

purpose.description: Donation purpose enum. Restricted to externally-permitted values per ADR-2605192115 §1.3 + §3.3. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the TitheRouter.donate() call (or LandRegistry interaction for in-kind donations bridged through escrow). Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Used to anchor this AT Protocol record to the on-chain Layer-1 event.

splitTxHash.description: Optional hex-encoded transaction hash of the Public Fund 10% split. In typical operation this is the same transaction as txHash (atomic split inside TitheRouter); recorded separately when the split occurs as a follow-up tx (e.g., during chaos-rehearsal Scenario 8 testing).

noteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.donation-note` record carrying a private message from the donor to the treasury Council seat. Use when the donor wishes to record reasoning or context confidentially. Encrypted per ADR-2605181100.

noteHashOnchain.description: Optional hex-encoded SHA-256 of the plaintext note (prefix `0x`, lowercase). Stored on-chain in the TitheRouter event; used to prove a specific note plaintext corresponds to this donation without revealing the plaintext.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of donation submission.
